# Nailed it by Sarah

> Professional nail studio in Gan Yavne, Israel, run by Sarah M.
> Specialises in gel manicures, anatomic nail builds, gel fills, French manicure and hand-painted nail art.

## Business facts

- **Name:** Nailed it by Sarah (Hebrew: נייל איט בי שרה)
- **Owner:** Sarah M — nail technician and nail artist, originally from Spain, raised in London, now based in Gan Yavne.
- **Location:** Ha-Atzma'ut Street 1, Gan Yavne, Israel (רחוב העצמאות 1, גן יבנה)
- **Phone / WhatsApp:** +972-53-272-7006 (053-272-7006)
- **Booking:** WhatsApp only — https://wa.me/972532727006
- **Instagram:** https://www.instagram.com/nailed_it_by.sarah/ (@nailed_it_by.sarah)
- **Google profile:** https://share.google/T1nJPHZBuAVe99DQA
- **Website:** https://nailed-it-by-sarah.vercel.app/
- **Languages spoken:** Hebrew, English, French, Spanish (Sarah is multilingual). The website is also available in Arabic.
- **Opening hours:** Sunday to Thursday, 09:00 to 21:00. Closed Friday and Saturday.
- **Founded:** 2020
- **Payment:** Cash, credit card, Bit. Currency: ILS (Israeli new shekel).
- **Areas served:** Gan Yavne, Yavne, Ashdod, Rehovot and surrounding central-Israel localities.

## Price list (ILS)

- Basic Manicure — ₪80
- Gel Manicure (with gel polish) — ₪100
- Anatomic Build — ₪130

- New Build (full set from natural nail) — ₪250
- Touch-ups — ₪5 / ₪10
- French / Pearl Powder — +₪20
- Design on one nail — ₪5 / ₪10

## Frequently asked

**How much does a gel manicure cost in Gan Yavne?**
A gel manicure at Nailed it by Sarah costs ₪100. A basic manicure costs ₪80. Book via WhatsApp at 053-272-7006.

**What are the opening hours?**
Sunday to Thursday, 09:00–21:00.

**How do I book an appointment?**
Booking is by WhatsApp on 053-272-7006 or by direct message on Instagram @nailed_it_by.sarah.

**What is an anatomic nail build?**
Anatomic build is a technique that uses gel to add length and shape to the natural nail with a strong, ergonomic apex. Prices start at ₪130.

**Where is the studio?**
Ha-Atzma'ut Street 1, Gan Yavne, Israel.
